title: Telemetry record: one line of logs/telemetry.jsonl per answer (guide chapter 10)

ts.description: When the answer was given, ISO 8601 with time zone

answer_id.description: Lets feedback arrive later and point at this answer; the audit log's request_id

user.description: The signed-in user (from the session, not the model)

path.description: governed = answered by a metric; sql_fallback = bypassed the layer

reason_code.description: Why a refused answer was refused; null otherwise. no_metric marks a coverage gap

metrics.description: Every metric that answered, with its version

data_as_of.description: The newest record the answer could use

unusual.description: Metrics whose figure was flagged as outside its usual range

answer_fingerprint.description: Hash of the values given; never the values themselves
